question: What gives rise to the circle-joined worship and what is its result?
premises: The circle-women and others will be explained later as fitting partners in power-union.
Union with them constitutes the circle-joined worship.
The circle-joined worship grants all fruits.
inference: When the appropriate power-partners are joined in the rite, the resulting circle-joined worship yields all desired results.
uncertainties: The specific identities of cakriṇī and related figures are deferred to later verses.
plain_english: The circle-women and other fitting partners in power-union will be explained later; worship joined with them becomes the circle-joined rite, which grants all fruits.
